messages:
Maya L: quick kick-off — we need a crisp benchmarking narrative for the launch: primary story = latency vs cost tradeoffs, plus clear CTA for webinar signup and inbound routing. want 3 chart variants (headline + one-liner), 2 headline options, and a routing map for leads (SMB / Mid-market / Enterprise). deadline: Monday EOD.

Devin K: love it. proposed chart ideas: 
1) real-world slice: latency on x, $/1k tokens on y, color by workload type (chat vs classif). shows where Redwood sits vs managed endpoints. simple callout: "lower tail latency, better median cost"
2) economic waterfall: token cost components (compute, memory, batching) stacked to show opportunities to save w/ batching + caching
3) time-to-serve CDF: % requests served under X ms (95/99) — communicates reliability + latency SLOs.

Samir P: for the marketing copy, two headline concepts: 
- Headline A (product-led): "Predictable latency. Pay less for every million tokens."
- Headline B (platform): "Serve reliably at scale — latency SLOs without surprise bills."
Pick A for PLG demos, B for enterprise landing pages.

Julia R: nit: wording "pay less" might read vague. suggest: "Lower per-token cost with smart batching and caching" as fallback. Also we should include an example: "Customer X reduced inference cost by 38% while improving median latency from 210ms -> 160ms." make sure numbers are hypothetical unless legal signs off.

Chris M: routing notes for inbound: 
- SMB leads -> growth@redwood.com, 2-day SLA, auto-book demo via calendly link (embed in CTA)
- Mid-market -> SDR queue, qualify for Dedicated trial, request case study
- Enterprise -> AE + Security/Compliance overlay, route to enterprise@redwood.com, attach private deployment brief
I'll create a simple flow diagram for the landing page and webinar follow-ups.

Maya L: good. for charts we need short captions for each variant and a 1-sentence key takeaway. Devin — can you draft captions today? Samir — can you pick headline A vs B for the webinar registration page? Julia — help with data framing + guard rails for example numbers (legal/comms). Chris — create routing flow and share cal link.

Devin K: caption drafts (raw):
- Chart 1 caption: "Real-world latency vs cost across workloads — Redwood moves the median left while compressing cost." Key takeaway: "Better tail latency and competitive unit economics for chat workloads."
- Chart 2 caption: "Breakdown of per-token cost — batching & caching reduce the compute slice." Key takeaway: "Operational levers reduce unit cost without sacrificing quality."
- Chart 3 caption: "Time-to-serve across requests — high percentage served under target SLOs." Key takeaway: "Consistent latency at scale enabled by smart routing."

Samir P: webinar copy pick: go with Headline B for registration — it signals enterprise-readiness which converts better for paid seats. CTA: "Reserve your spot — see real demos & benchmarks". Also propose secondary line: "Includes live Q&A on deployment and cost optimization."

Julia R: I'll draft a short legal-safe example: "In a representative internal test, batching + KV caching reduced per-token compute cost by ~30% and improved median latency by ~20%. Results vary by workload." That should be OK to run by comms/legal.

Chris M: routing flow draft posted in figma link: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/routing — (I'll add notes: webhook to CRM, tag with lead_size and trial_interest). Also putting Calendly for SMB demos: https://calendly.com/redwood/smb-demo

engbot: notice: webinar registration form currently has a 3-field flow; conversion on our last webinar was 18%. recommended add an optional checkbox "interested in Dedicated" to help routing.

Maya L: action items recap:
- Devin: finalize captions + export 3 chart PNGs (owner) — due Fri 2pm
- Samir: finalize registration headline + CTA copy (owner) — due Fri 5pm
- Julia: legal-safe example + vet with comms/legal (owner) — due Mon 10am
- Chris: finalize inbound routing diagram + update CRM mappings (owner) — due Mon 5pm
- Maya: assemble landing + webinar page copy + share in doc for review — due Mon EOD

Samir P: +1. also recommend A/B the registration headline for first 24h to see what drives signups.

Devin K: will prepare alt layout where chart 1 is hero on page, chart 3 goes into webinar deck.

Julia R: tagging @SamirP @DevinK to start legal review thread once drafts are ready.

Chris M: noted — will add routing rules to the form backend and set up SDR handoff in HubSpot.

Maya L: thanks all — if anyone needs to re-prioritize let me know. :thumbsup:

Samir P: nice. low-effort ask for growth: include a 1-slide "how costs translate" that maps tokens -> $ for 3 example request sizes (chat prompt 50 tokens, long generation 300 tokens, embeddings 1536 dims) — helps reps.

Devin K: adding that to chart 2 as a tiny inset.

engbot: automated note: benchmark dataset used for internal tests: bench-suite-v4 (seq dist: chat-heavy). contact infra-team for specifics.
